programme.title: Dark Arts TV
programme.desc: The Dark Arts TV team visits Bihl Manor in Fremont, Ohio, a 19th-century home later turned children’s group residence. Surrounded by stories of ghostly children, shadowy figures, and mysterious footsteps, the manor has earned a lasting reputation as one of the region’s most haunted sites—where the line between legend and reality may not be as distant as it seems.

programme.title: Psychic Witness
programme.desc: In Illinois, a 16-year-old boy goes to speak with a contractor about a summer job. He tells his mother it'll only take a minute, but no one ever sees him again. Working with psychics Carol Broman and Dorothy Allison, police identify the kidnapper and discover he's killed many others. When two women are abducted and found stabbed to death outside Morristown, NJ, police believe they have a serial killer on their hands. Local psychic Nancy Orlen Weber works with detectives to try and catch him before he finds his next victim.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show
programme.desc: What on Earth are they spraying? Richard travels into the field to meet several researchers who present compelling evidence that chemicals or biological agents are being deliberately sprayed into the atmosphere by some shadowy government agency. Theories as to why they are spraying range from weather control, depopulation and mind control.

programme.title: Virginia Paranormal Case Files
programme.desc: The team at Virginia Paranormal Investigations travels the state investigating claims of paranormal activity and compiling the Virginia Paranormal Case Files. The show offers a balanced look at paranormal investigation. VAPI has a reputation for being honest and approaching each case with an open mind. The evidence is real, the people are real, and the reports are real.
